title: A bill to designate the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Lynchburg, Virginia, as the "Private First Class Desmond T. Doss VA Clinic".
official_summary: This act designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Lynchburg, Virginia, as the Private First Class Desmond T. Doss VA Clinic.

summary.headline: Names the VA outpatient clinic in Lynchburg, Virginia, the "Private First Class Desmond T. Doss VA Clinic."
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Lynchburg, Virginia, after Private First Class Desmond T. Doss.
